summary: BCB Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 results (net loss of $14.8 million, EPS -$0.85) and a board proposal to reincorporate from New Jersey to Delaware and de-stagger the board, subject to shareholder approval. The filing is a routine earnings release with a governance change announcement; it does not constitute a special situation such as a merger, tender, or activist campaign. The reincorporation is procedural and pending shareholder vote. No deal terms or strategic alternatives were disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval of the reincorporation and any further operational updates.
